Ableton Youtube Player V1 AbletonDrummer.note: Embeds a YouTube player in Live for playback and resampling.

Backspin v1.0.2.note: DJ tape-stop, wind-down, rewind and backspin effects.

Chorb.note: Chord generator with built-in scaler and pitch randomiser.

Copy Machine.note: Plays multiple simultaneous copies of one audio file.

Glitchera.note: Adds random glitches and clicks to incoming audio.

HarmoChordBass J74.note: Plays a bass line from detected chord roots; part of HarmoTools.

HarmoChordRecv J74.note: Receives chord data from HarmoChord; part of the HarmoTools pack.

HarmoGuessScale J74.note: Detects key and scale of incoming MIDI; part of HarmoTools.

HarmoScaleFilter J74.note: Constrains incoming MIDI to the detected scale; part of HarmoTools.

HarmoTonicFilter J74.note: Filters MIDI notes to the current harmonic context; part of HarmoTools.

Inflation.note: Clone of the Sonnox Oxford Inflator loudness processor.

LFO Random.note: Live's LFO modulator restricted to random shapes only.

Learn Scales.note: Music theory helper that displays notes of a chosen scale.

MDD___ARPOoO_V2.note: Arpeggiator modelled on the Roland SH-101 and Jupiter-6.

MFA Audiodubber.note: Audio-triggered probabilistic modulation gate; part of Mod Squad bundle.

MFA Errata.note: Bit-shifting digital distortion with filtering and stereo width.

MFA MIDI ADSRx.note: MIDI-triggered ADSR envelope modulator; part of Mod Squad bundle.

MFA MIDI LFOx.note: MIDI-triggered synchronised LFO modulator; part of Mod Squad bundle.

MFA Note Raum.note: MIDI note echo with limit, wrap and bounce reflection modes.

Mapr16x2.note: Multi-parameter mapper based on the Mothergarage Multimapper.

NTS Streamer.note: Streams NTS Radio directly inside Ableton Live.

NirvanaFX.note: Feedback device; audio-effect version of the Nirvana instrument.

Note Triggered Modulator.note: Variable-length parameter sequencer advanced by incoming MIDI notes.

Potee.note: A single knob that generates MIDI notes as you turn it.

Ravel 1.1.note: Creates and colours chords in real time from any MIDI controller.

Sektor.note: FFT frequency gate splitting audio into four routable bands.

SimulScrub-v6.note: Plays several simultaneous scrubbing copies of an audio file.

The Lot Radio.note: Streams The Lot Radio's live DJ mixes inside Live.

html instruments.note: Lets you play web-based HTML instruments inside Ableton Live.

jBBL v3.3.note: Bucket-brigade delay inspired by the Moog 104.

jDisperser3 v1.1.note: Smears high-energy transients through space and time.

jMackie-Feedback v4.0.note: Mackie mixer inspired negative feedback loop EQ distortion.

jSpring-Tank v1.3.note: Spring reverb ported to gen~ from a Reaktor ensemble.

trnr.Hatster.note: Hi-hat synthesizer with modelled low-pass gate and LFOs.
